description: START HERE. Long-form guidance for agents: principles (trustless, human sign-off on every tx, verify before sign, confirm with read_chain, never touch seed phrases, always give short + full links), the full tool catalog with when-to-use, and end-to-end workflows: find-money (find_money/find_money_batch → read_chain → signing_guide/recovery_guide → verify_tx → human sign-off → broadcast_tx → tx_status → build_swap_link/get_quote/build_swap_tx → verify → sign → broadcast), best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet. workflow=<id> for one, full=true (default when no workflow) for everything. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
name: swapchan_playbook
title: SwapChan agent playbook (how to use every tool together)
